mapper.select: /* SQL ID : TkexamAnswShtDAO.qstnTkexamAnswShtCtsList 설 명 : 문항시험응시답안목록조회 */ SELECT EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID , EXAMPPR.QSTN_VWITM_DSPLY_SEQ , ANSW_SHT.ANSW_SHT_CTS , (SELECT QSTN_VWITM_DSPLY_SEQ FROM TB_LMS_EXAMPPR WHERE QSTN_ID = #{qstnId} AND EXAMPPR_ID = #{exampprId}) AS BASE_DSPLY_SEQNO , ANSW_SHT.SCR , EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID , ANSW_SHT.TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT_ID , ANSW_SHT.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAMPPR EXAMPPR JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW_SHT ON EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID = ANSW_SHT.EXAMPPR_ID AND EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID = ANSW_SHT.QSTN_ID WHERE EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID = #{qstnId}

/* SQL ID : TkexamAnswShtDAO.stdntExampprAnswShtList 설 명 : 학생시험지응시답안목록조회 */ SELECT EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID , ANSW.ANSW_SHT_CTS FROM TB_LMS_EXAMPPR EXAMPPR JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW ON EXAMPPR.EXAMPPR_ID = ANSW.EXAMPPR_ID AND EXAMPPR.USER_ID = ANSW.USER_ID AND EXAMPPR.QSTN_ID = ANSW.QSTN_ID WHERE EXAMPPR.TKEXAM_ID = #{tkexamId} AND EXAMPPR.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY EXAMPPR.QSTN_DSPLY_SEQNO
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : TkexamAnswShtDAO.stdntSsnlQstnTempSave 설 명 : 학생단일문항임시저장 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT ANSW_SHT USING ( SELECT EXAMPPR_ID , QSTN_ID , USER_ID , #{answShtCts} AS ANSW_SHT_CTS FROM TB_LMS_EXAMPPR WHERE TKEXAM_ID = #{tkexamId} AND QSTN_ID = #{qstnId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} ) CTS ON ( ANSW_SHT.EXAMPPR_ID = CTS.EXAMPPR_ID AND ANSW_SHT.QSTN_ID = CTS.QSTN_ID AND ANSW_SHT.USER_ID = CTS.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ANSW_SHT.ANSW_SHT_CTS = CTS.ANSW_SHT_CTS , ANSW_SHT.MDFR_ID = CTS.USER_ID , ANSW_SHT.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TKEXAM_ANSW_SHT_ID , EXAMPPR_ID , QSTN_ID , USER_ID , ANSW_SHT_CTS , SCR , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( FN_NEW_ID('TKANS') , CTS.EXAMPPR_ID , CTS.QSTN_ID , CTS.USER_ID , CTS.ANSW_SHT_CTS , 0 , CTS.USER_ID , FN_DTTM() )
